description: An expander that carries the extra voices, or a duplicate set of outputs, from a MIDI Poly and MPE module

outputs.text: The pitch of each voice this expander carries, at 1V per octave, one poly channel per voice
10V while the voice this expander carries is sounding, one poly channel per voice
The note-on velocity of each voice this expander carries, 0V to 10V
A second copy of each voice's pitch, offset by the random detune amount set on the MIDIpolyMPE
The per-note aftertouch of each voice this expander carries, 0V to 10V
The note-off velocity of each voice this expander carries, 0V to 10V

notes: It gives out nothing until a MIDIpolyMPE module in the patch has its xpander field set to the letter shown at the top of this panel; the two do not have to be next to one another
Click the letters at the top to choose which of the four expander slots this module takes
The xpander field on the MIDIpolyMPE also chooses how it is used: carrying the voices above that module's own count, or repeating every voice's outputs here
